premise: The humble beginnings of a Delta blues legend who played on street corners before recording hits.
hook: He worked as a tractor driver in Mississippi cotton fields while earning coins by singing gospel and blues on street corners.
key_facts: Worked on a cotton plantation in Indianola, Mississippi, during his youth.
Traveled to Memphis, Tennessee, seeking a radio break, eventually working as a disc jockey known as the Beale Street Blues Boy.
Named his signature Gibson electric guitars 'Lucille' after an incident involving a tavern fire.
Recorded dozens of influential blues standards over a decades-long touring career.

premise: A young football player cut from the Canadian Football League finds himself with seven dollars and no backup plan.
hook: He had seven dollars in his pocket after his sports dream ended. Then he stepped into a wrestling ring.
key_facts: Played college football for the University of Miami national championship team
Cut from the Calgary Stampeders in the CFL early in his professional career
Transitioned to professional wrestling under the name Rocky Maivia before achieving global fame
Became one of the highest-paid actors in Hollywood

premise: A college dropout builds a computer in his parents' garage with his friend during the 1970s tech boom.
hook: Before building iPhones, he dropped out of college, slept on friends' floors, and built circuit boards in a garage.
key_facts: Dropped out of Reed College after attending for one semester
Co-founded Apple Computer in 1976 inside a suburban garage
Traveled to India seeking spiritual guidance prior to starting Apple

premise: Facing eviction and having only seven dollars to his name before finding his footing in professional wrestling.
hook: Before he was a global movie star, his family was evicted with only seven dollars in their pockets.
key_facts: Played college football for the University of Miami and briefly in the Canadian Football League.
Suffered a career-ending shoulder injury that led to being cut from his football team.
Entered professional wrestling with the WWF as Rocky Maivia.
Transformed into 'The Rock' and became one of the most popular wrestlers in history.

premise: A routine bus ride in Montgomery, Alabama leads to an arrest that ignites a historic civil rights movement.
hook: One quiet refusal on a crowded bus sparked a 381-day boycott.
key_facts: Employed as a seamstress and active in the Montgomery NAACP chapter.
Refused to surrender her bus seat to a white passenger on December 1, 1955.
Her arrest led directly to the Montgomery bus boycott, altering American history.

premise: A struggling single mother writes fantasy chapters in Edinburgh cafes while depending on state benefits.
hook: Before selling millions of books, she wrote manuscript pages in local cafes while keeping warm with her baby.
key_facts: Conceived the idea for a wizarding school while on a delayed train in 1990.
Completed the first novel while living in Edinburgh amid financial hardship.
Faced multiple rejections from publishing houses before Bloomsbury accepted the manuscript.

premise: An Indian mathematician decides to abandon commercial coaching to tutor thirty underprivileged students for free.
hook: He turned down lucrative corporate teaching offers to teach thirty impoverished kids for free.
key_facts: Founded the educational program Super 30 in Patna, India, in 2002.
Provided free residential coaching, food, and lodging to students from low-income families.
Achieved high success rates with students qualifying for the Indian Institute of Technology entrance exams.

premise: A young animator loses the rights to his first major cartoon character before creating a globally famous mouse.
hook: After his first successful cartoon character was stolen, he drew a little mouse on a train ride home.
key_facts: Created Oswald the Lucky Rabbit for Universal Pictures, only to lose the contract and character rights in 1928.
Created Mickey Mouse during a train journey following the loss of his previous studio work.
Produced Steamboat Willie, one of the first sound cartoons, achieving mainstream success.
